senses.gloss:
mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Desirous of removing.
E.
णुद to send, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Sent, thrown, despatched, cast, dismissed.
E.
णुद to send, aff. क्त, form irr.; also नुत्त.

ind.
1 Certainly, assuredly.
2 A particle of doubt or deliberation.
3 A reminiscent particle.
4 An expletive.
E.
नू a particle, नम to bow or bend, aff. विच्, deriv. irr.
